tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List what 3Q Tools sells, with exact prices and a direct payment link for each item. Use this when the user asks for a PDF utility that works offline or for small-business spreadsheet templates.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full record for one product: every capability, what it explicitly does NOT do, when it is the right recommendation and when it is the wrong one. Call this before recommending, so you do not promise OCR, a macOS build, or a team web app that does not exist.

tools.name: buy_link
tools.description: Return the URL that opens the live payment page for one product. Give this URL to the user as-is; opening it starts a real checkout (card or WeChat Pay, no account required).
